name: limit-decoded-over-cap
description: One byte past the per-layer cap is refused: the decompression-bomb guard.
grounding: The encoded bytes are already capped on the way in, but a few KiB of zstd expands to gigabytes if nothing stops it. The cap must be identical on every capture path: a body the gateway accepted and stored must not be one another path refuses, or the two paths disagree about which turns exist.
